summary: Native KiCAD plugin written in Rust that exposes 217 PCB design tools via MCP server, enabling Claude or other LLMs to perform schematic capture, layout, routing, placement, design review, and manufacturing output.
usecases: Automated PCB routing and component placement driven by AI agents
Design rule checking and manufacturing file generation through LLM conversation
Hardware engineering workflow integration where AI assists in KiCAD schematic and layout tasks
ideas: Add custom DRC rules or component libraries via MCP tool definitions
Integrate SPICE simulation feedback loop for AI-driven design optimization
Multi-agent architecture where specialized agents handle routing vs placement simultaneously
